Chuck Mangione – Children of Sanchez (Original 2-LP Set)

Original A&M Records double LP of Chuck Mangione's Grammy Award-winning soundtrack for the Hall Bartlett film Children of Sanchez.

Featuring Mangione's signature flugelhorn along with sweeping orchestral arrangements, Latin jazz rhythms, and cinematic compositions, this is considered one of his finest works.

Includes

  • Children of Sanchez Overture
  • Lullabye
  • Pilgrimage
  • Consuelo's Love Theme
  • Bellavia
  • Children of Sanchez Finale

A beautiful addition for collectors of jazz fusion, film scores, and late-1970s A&M releases.

Condition

Records: VG+ / EX (Visually Graded)

  • Both LPs retain excellent gloss.
  • Minimal visible sleeve marks.
  • No deep scratches observed.
  • Not play tested unless otherwise noted.

Cover: VG

  • Clean front cover with strong color.
  • Moderate age spotting/foxing on the rear cover.
  • Light edge and corner wear.
  • No major seam splits.
  • Please examine all photos for the exact condition.
